critical_bugs.issue: Fallback AJAX URL uses form.action but form has no action attribute
critical_bugs.impact: If mydefenselawData is undefined, form submission will fail
critical_bugs.recommendation: Set form action attribute or provide hardcoded fallback to /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php

critical_bugs.issue: No focus trap implementation in modal
critical_bugs.impact: Keyboard users can tab out of modal to background content, breaking accessibility
critical_bugs.recommendation: Implement focus trap using focusable element detection and tab key interception

critical_bugs.issue: Direct use of $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] without proxy header check
critical_bugs.impact: IP address may be incorrect if site is behind proxy/CDN (Cloudflare, etc)
critical_bugs.recommendation: Check HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR or HTTP_CF_CONNECTING_IP headers first

critical_bugs.issue: Phone validation too permissive - only checks length >= 10
critical_bugs.impact: Accepts invalid phone numbers like 'aaaaaaaaaa' or '1111111111'
critical_bugs.recommendation: Use regex to validate actual phone number format: /^[\d\s\-\(\)\.]{10,}$/ and check for digit count

critical_bugs.issue: No contact form exists in template - only modal form
critical_bugs.impact: JavaScript references contactForm (line 26, 228) which is undefined unless there's a separate contact page
critical_bugs.recommendation: Verify contactForm element exists or remove unused initialization

strengths: Excellent form validation with real-time feedback
Good error handling and user feedback
User confirmation email is good UX
weaknesses: No focus trap for keyboard accessibility
IP address detection incomplete for proxies
No analytics tracking for form events
overall_assessment.security_posture: Good - nonce verification, input sanitization, and email validation all properly implemented. Recommend adding rate limiting and honeypot.
overall_assessment.accessibility_posture: Fair - Basic ARIA attributes present but missing focus trap and some announcements. Modal is usable but not fully WCAG 2.1 AA compliant.
overall_assessment.user_experience: Excellent - Real-time validation, clear error messages, loading states, success notifications, and confirmation emails provide great UX.
